questions.question: What is a purchase voucher? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• What is a Purchase V oucher?
  • A Purchase V oucher is an accounting document used to record all purchase transactions of
  • goods or services in Tally. It plays a vital role in maintaining accurate purchase records and
  • updating inventory and accounts.
  • In Tally, a Purchase V oucher is created using F9 (Purchase Voucher). It records details such
  • as the supplier’s name, invoice number, date, quantity, rate, and total amount . It can be
  • recorded in two modes: Item Invoice Mode (affects both inventory and accounts) and
  • Accounting Invoice Mode (affects only accounts).
  • When goods are purchased, the purchase voucher increases the stock quantity and records the
  • liability towards the supplier. It also helps in calculating taxes such as GST automatically.
  • Purchase vouchers are important for tracking expenses, maintaining supplier records, and
  • preparing financial statements. They also help in verifying purchase transactions during audits.
  • Thus, a Purchase V oucher is an essential tool for recording and managing purchase activities
  • in a systematic and accurate manner.

questions.question: Describe the procedure for creating, displaying, altering, and deleting Stock Items. / [CO3] [5x4 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Procedure for Creating, Displaying, Altering, and Deleting Stock Items
  • Stock Items represent the goods handled by a business and are essential for inventory
  • management in Tally. Proper management of stock items ensures accurate tracking and
  • reporting.
  • To create a stock item , go to Gateway of Tally → Inventory Info → Stock Items → Create .
  • Enter details such as Name, Stock Group, Unit of Measurement, Rate, and Opening Balance ,
  • then save.
  • To display a stock item, go to Display → Inventory Books → Stock Item. This allows users to
  • view details without making any changes.
  • To alter a stock item , select Inventory Info → Stock Items → Alter , choose the item, make
  • necessary changes, and save.
  • To delete a stock item , open it in alter mode and press Alt + D . This will remove the item
  • permanently.
  • These functions help in maintaining accurate inventory records, updating information when
  • required, and ensuring smooth business operations.
